startErrorDetail: The request is saved in this conversation. Send a message to try again; you can keep using the workspace.
retainedSummary: Return to an assignment, or remove pending code you no longer need.
copyRemoved: Pending code was removed. Recorded changes and workspace files are still available.
retainedHelp: Stored code and checks that have not been activated. Removing them does not reverse edits already saved in your workspace.
retainedEmptyBody: Development conversations and recorded changes remain available after activation or cleanup.
discardTitle: Stop work and remove pending code?
discardBody: Work on this assignment will stop. Unactivated code and its checks will be removed. Workspace edits, active plugins and recorded history will stay. Reversing saved edits is a separate request.
developmentIntro: Describe your assignment. It can involve several connections, plugins and workspace files.
scope: Workspace edits are saved as work proceeds. Plugin code becomes active separately, after the related changes pass checks.
developmentHelpIntro: This is a separate chat for a development assignment. It can create or change several connections, plugins and other workspace files. A plugin you selected is starting context, not a limit on access.
developmentHelpSteps: Describe what you want to connect, see or change. Situate looks for connections it can reuse and explains missing access or technical limitations.
Review and refine. Open Changes to see what changed, then ask for adjustments in the chat. Use Files in the sidebar to browse your workspace.
Check the result. Situate checks related code together and activates it after required checks pass and affected running actions finish. Account access may still need setup.
developmentHelpSafety: Development has the same workspace access as ordinary chat, within your request. Checks use synthetic examples and temporary test data. External effects still need your approval. The file panel is for inspection, not an access boundary.
generalError: Something went wrong. This view could not be loaded.
checkingDetail: Checking changed connections and plugins together with the dependency versions they use.
failedDetail: Related code has not been activated. Saved workspace edits remain. Ask to address the failed checks before trying again.
adoptedDetail: The checked code is active. Workspace edits were saved separately. Review any access still needed below; the original conversation has not resumed.
discardedDetail: The conversation, recorded history and saved workspace edits remain. Send a new request to continue development.
noPackages: Connections and plugins will appear as the work takes shape.
workspaceEditsHelp: These edits are already saved. They do not wait for plugin activation.
reusedHelp: Reuse the existing connection and its configured access. Each tool keeps its own account choices.
discoveryHelp: These connections and plugins belong to the same assignment. Other affected files can be added as work proceeds.

activationLabels.failed: Activation failed · previous code still active

activationDetails.pending: Existing active versions remain available while changes are prepared.
activationDetails.ready: The related code passed checks. Activation will wait for affected actions to finish.
activationDetails.waiting: Affected actions can finish. They will not be aborted or repeated for this update.
activationDetails.failed: The related code was not activated. Saved workspace edits remain.
activationDetails.uncertain: Do not repeat activation yet. Ask to check which revisions are active; saved workspace edits remain.
activationDetails.active: The checked revisions are active together. Account or permission setup may still be needed.
activationDetails.notification-failed: The code is already active. Only the notice to the original conversation failed; do not activate again.

controls.longNames: Use long assignment and package names
controls.platformHelp: Synthetic availability and layout only. This does not establish native integration or iOS support.

readiness.unsupported: Required access is not supported on this platform

readinessDetails.ready: Code is available. Connected accounts and each tool’s account choices determine which data it can use.
readinessDetails.permission: Allow access before using this connection. Code inspection and independent checks remain available.
readinessDetails.not-implemented: This connection has no implementation for the selected platform. Connecting an account will not add one.
readinessDetails.unsupported: The required platform access is unavailable. Dependent functions cannot run here; their code remains available to inspect.
readinessDetails.failed: The last operation failed. This is not a code-check result or evidence that account setup succeeded.
